name: resident-statement
title: Accommodation statement
for_each: select c.id, r.name || ' ' || c.term as label from contracts c join residents r on r.id = c.resident_id where c.status = 'signed' order by r.name

sections.title: Your stay
sections.sql: select r.name as resident, c.term, b.name as building, rm.name as room, c.starts_on, c.ends_on from contracts c join residents r on r.id = c.resident_id left join rooms rm on rm.id = c.room_id left join buildings b on b.id = rm.building_id where c.id = $1

sections.title: Charges
sections.sql: select due_on, description, amount_cents, (select value from settings where key = 'currency') as currency from charges where contract_id = $1 order by due_on, id

sections.title: Payments received
sections.sql: select received_on, reference, amount_cents, (select value from settings where key = 'currency') as currency from payments where contract_id = $1 order by received_on

sections.title: Balance
sections.note: Charges due to today less payments received.
sections.sql: select due_cents, paid_cents, balance_cents, (select value from settings where key = 'currency') as currency from balances where contract_id = $1

name: complaints-log
title: Complaints log
for_each: select id, name from buildings order by name

sections.title: Complaints received
sections.note: Kept and made available to residents under clause 31(5) of the Pastoral Care Code. Names are left off.
sections.sql: select received_on, summary, case when code_related then 'Yes' else 'No' end as about_the_code, coalesce(response, 'Open') as response, resolved_on from complaints where building_id = $1 order by received_on desc

name: evacuation-roll
title: Evacuation roll
for_each: select id, name from buildings order by name

sections.title: Residents in the building today
sections.note: Print before a drill or an emergency. Under-18 residents are marked so their guardian is contacted (clause 27(1)(c)(iii)).
sections.sql: select rm.floor, rm.name as room, lc.resident, case when r.date_of_birth > (current_date - interval '18 years')::date then 'Under 18' else '' end as note, coalesce(r.phone, '') as phone, coalesce(r.emergency_contact, '') as emergency_contact from live_contracts lc join rooms rm on rm.id = lc.room_id join residents r on r.id = lc.resident_id where rm.building_id = $1 order by rm.floor, rm.name, lc.resident
